title: Quantifying molecular aggregation by super resolution microscopy within an excitatory synapse from mouse hippocampal neurons
protocol: Save each MSR image file into TIFF file format using ImageJ (Fiji).
Load TIFF images into MetaMorph software.
Use threshold image function to verify the dynamic range of grayscale values in the image.
Select arithmetic function from process menu to subtract a set gray value from the source image.
In the arithmetic dialog box, choose the image of interest as source image 1.
Under source 2, select constant value and enter 32768 gray levels.
Select operation as subtract.
Apply changes to obtain the subtracted image.
Save the generated image as a new TIFF file.
Reload background corrected TIFF images into MetaMorph.
Check if the image is calibrated under the edit menu, select image info.
If the image is not calibrated, display X and Y calibration in pixels.
From the measure menu, use calibrate distances command to calibrate distances.
Input X and Y calibration in real units according to the sampling of images during acquisition.
Select apply after inputting the calibration values.
Calibrate distances for confocal PSD95 images.
Open all images at once in MetaMorph.
Select apply to all open images from the calibrate distances dialog box.
Repeat calibration steps 1–5 for all images.
Load background-corrected and calibrated confocal image of PSD95 in MetaMorph.
From measure menu, select show region statistics command.
Measure average intensity and standard deviation of intensity for the entire confocal PSD95 image.
Select objects in the confocal PSD95 image with intensity higher than average intensity plus standard deviation of the image.
Set the threshold state to inclusive and input the low threshold value to 25 gray levels.
Assign pseudocolour as orange to identify selected puncta above the threshold.
Filter synaptic puncta using morphological filters.
Set length filter to >= 0.06 μm.
Set breadth filter to >= 0.045 μm.
Set area filter to >= 0.006 μm².
Open the Integrated Morphometry Analysis (IMA) dialog box.
Select the source image as confocal PSD95.
Measure and create an object mask.
Generate a binary IMA object mask as an output image.
Create ROIs on the filtered objects using MetaMorph software.
Select the create regions around objects option from the region menu in MetaMorph.
Draw ROIs around all filtered objects or synaptic puncta.
Mark the boundary of each object with a yellow color.
Create ROIs around objects filtered with IMA object mask.
Mark the ROIs in yellow color.
Save all ROIs to a region (.rgn) file from the regions menu.
Reload multiple ROIs saved to a region file to the image of interest, such as the IMA object mask.
Transfer ROIs from one image to another using transfer regions function.
Clear all ROIs from an image using clear all regions function.
Load background corrected and calibrated STED image of PSD95 in MetaMorph.
Open PSD95 STED image in MetaMorph for analysis.
Perform object-based segmentation as described previously.
Select objects with intensity higher than the average intensity plus two times the standard deviation of the entire image.
Filter objects through IMA similar to steps 7e and 7f.
Generate a binary IMA object mask as an output image.
Create ROIs and save all ROIs to a region file similar to steps 7g and 7h.
Filter synapses or functional zones of the synapse from confocal/STED synaptic marker images.
Save region files that denote detected functional compartments.
Load STED super-resolution image of proteins of interest in TIFF format into MetaMorph software.
Display the loaded STED APP image in pseudocolor mode.
In data tab of PALMTracer, check source image selected should be STED APP (subject image).
Tick high resolution destination in data tab of PALMTracer.
Select zoom (XY sampling) as 1 in data tab of PALMTracer.
Tick autosave to save data generated automatically in data tab of PALMTracer.
Input spatial calibration as 0.015 μm (sampling 15 nm during imaging) in options tab of PALMTracer.
Tick filtering, ROI, all, and HR ROI in filtering tab of PALMTracer.
Tick watershed algorithm in MetaMorph program.
Select bi-dimensional Gaussian fitting for cluster analysis.
Set sigma for the Gaussian fit as 1 pixel.
Set size for Gaussian fitting as 7 pixels.
Set theta (free angle) as 45 degrees.
Tick sort axes to extract principal and auxiliary axes.
Set threshold to auto threshold.
